description: One metric per resource family for the fleet dots on the Bridge. The head first asks count by (resource_urn) ({resource_urn=~"..."}) with no metric name; if Insights rejects that, it switches to these metrics, one query per family and region. metric is the family's seen probe: a sample in the last five minutes lights the dot, and deep water counts the family as reporting. moved_by, where present, is the metric deep water compares with its pre-load baseline to say whether the family moved with the load; without it, metric serves both. verified true means the name is in the region catalog (watcher/catalog, from label/__name__/values); scripts/check_metric_names.py fails CI on a name that is not, and the head logs a warning at startup.

database.source: tor1 catalog 2026-10-09; moved_by from deep-water v-670380 (load average 0.16 to 0.97 under 8 clients, CPU 15 to 21 %, B-035)
